title: Shared definitions for banking-risk-compliance skill schemas
description: Shared $defs that per-skill schemas in this plugin commonly redefine. Per-skill schemas should $ref these via "../_defs.json#/$defs/<name>" rather than redefining the same enums and shapes inline. Plugin-specific extras (banking_supervisor_enum, mra_mria_classification_enum, heightened_standards_applicability_enum) sit alongside the base definitions.

severity_enum_with_moderate.description: Variant ladder used by FRB / OCC / FDIC / NYDFS exam findings and audit reports where 'moderate' has settled meaning.

confidence_label.description: Author confidence in the artifact as a whole.

owner_role.description: Named firm function or role with accountability (e.g., 'CRO', 'Chief Compliance Officer', 'Chief Credit Officer', 'Treasurer', 'Head of Capital', 'BSA Officer'). Never an individual person.

human_review_gate.description: Embedded human-review-gate descriptor. Common banking gates: pre-exam materials sign-off, MRA / MRIA response approval, board risk-committee adoption (Reg YY, Heightened Standards).

banking_supervisor_enum.description: Primary or relevant supervisor named in the artifact. Drives terminology (MRA vs. MRBA), exam-cycle expectations, and report formatting.

mra_mria_classification_enum.description: Examiner finding classification. MRA = Matter Requiring Attention (FRB, OCC). MRIA = Matter Requiring Immediate Attention (FRB). MRBA = Matter Requiring Board Attention (FDIC). 'n/a' for findings outside US banking supervision.

heightened_standards_applicability_enum.description: OCC Heightened Standards (12 CFR 30 Appendix D) applicability. Drives risk-governance framework expectations and second-line independence requirements.
